text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More than 12,000 jobs will be created in Zimbabwe from new investment projects worth over Z$9.5 billion approved in 1996, the Zimbabwe Investment Centre said on Monday.

- The president and chief operations officer of the Coca-Cola Company, Douglas Ivester, arrives in Zimbabwe on Tuesdas and is expected to announce a major investment in the southern African country by the soft drink giant.

- Zimbabwe's police chief, Commissioner Augustine Chihuri, has blamed the chaotic sitution on the capital Harare's roads on bad planning and the haphazard allocation of commuter omnibus ranks within the city.
